component.name: Konvert
component.summary: High-performance file converter and optimizer for Linux and KDE Plasma

description.p: Konvert is a fast, lightweight, offline, and native file conversion and optimization utility crafted for Linux and KDE Plasma.

ul.li: Dolphin Context Menu Integration: Convert photos, videos, audio, and documents directly from the right-click menu without opening heavy applications.
Privacy-first and 100% Offline: Zero telemetry and zero cloud dependencies; all files are converted locally using native system resources.
Multi-threaded Performance: Powered by Rust and Rayon to batch-process hundreds of files in parallel.
Smart Target Sizing: Automatically optimize videos and images for Discord (8 MB limit), email attachments (25 MB limit), and the web.
Media and Document Support: Convert between WebP, PNG, JPEG, AVIF, JXL, MP4, WebM, MKV, GIF, MP3, WAV, UDF, and PDF.
Conversion History and Savings: Track space savings, view preview thumbnails, and quickly open files in Dolphin.

description.p: Patch release 0.5.1 fixing KDE Plasma 6 Dolphin submenu parent icon resolution, enabling PIE for Qt6 Network binaries, pinning x86_64 CI builds to Ubuntu 24.04 for broader Qt 6.8 compatibility (Debian 13 Trixie), and improving install.sh Qt6 dependency detection.

Release 0.5.0 delivering live pause/resume/cancel job control across CLI, KDE JobViewV2, and Qt6 GUI, hardware-accelerated video encoder fixes (NVENC VBR, VA-API VP9/AV1, SVT-AV1 preset mapping, 2-pass target sizing), full CLI/doctor/GUI i18n parity, single-instance GUI activation, hardened desktop integrations, and expanded test coverage.

Release 0.4.0 delivering Single Source of Truth (SSoT) config persistence, live KDE Plasma progress bar and D-Bus ETA notifications, true vector Potrace tracing for SVG output, konvert --doctor system diagnostics, full converter error i18n localization, native symbolic icon support for KDE accent color binding, and modular CLI architecture.

Release 0.3.0 introducing multi-threaded Rayon batch conversions, conversion preset profiles (web, balanced, archive, lossless), stdin/stdout pipeline streaming, accurate batch ETA calculation, AppImage packaging, automated update checking, and multi-desktop file manager integrations.

Release 0.2.0 introducing multi-threaded Rayon parallel batch processing, LTO compiler optimizations, SVG/ICO/HEIC/BMP format conversions, native Lucide SVG action icons, live animated terminal progress bar, and comprehensive stability and security fixes.
